fail_to_pass: no sources gives an empty object, and null or undefined sources are skipped
undefined skips the key, null overwrites it
an object replaces a primitive and a primitive replaces an object
the result shares no object or array with any source
a source is not changed even when later sources merge into the same keys
dates, maps, functions and class instances are kept by reference
a class instance is not merged into, it replaces
nested __proto__, constructor and prototype keys are ignored at every depth
blocked keys inside arrays of objects are dropped too
objects with a null prototype count as plain
a source that is not a plain object is refused
a cycle is refused wherever it is
the same object used twice without a cycle is fine
only own enumerable string keys are read
merges nested objects with later sources winning
